findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:1382-1388 stripCodeLikeTokens over-strips: its hyphen/dot token-stripping regex (/\b[A-Za-z0-9_]+(?:[-.][A-Za-z0-9_]+)+\b/g) removes the SHRINKAGE TRIGGER WORD ITSELF whenever it is hyphenated or dotted to an adjacent word, e.g. deferred-for-now, excluded-here, partial-ly, narrow-ed, remaining-work, remaining-scope. Verified live: stripCodeLikeTokens("The remaining-work was left for later.") -> "The   was left for later." no longer matches claimsShrinkage, and "deferred-for-now"/"excluded-here" strip to empty. This defeats the DONE-gate unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage guard for ordinary, non-adversarial phrasing an author or LLM may naturally write (not just genuine file paths like core/partial-done-recovery.ts, which was the intended target). The adversarial verification intents for CHK-001 (sanitize-path-tokens:adversarial) and CHK-003 (remaining-breadth-decision:adversarial) required proving the sanitizer/narrowing does not become a bypass for genuine shrinkage claims, but the smoke suite (proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts) has no case where the trigger word itself is hyphenated/dotted -- only cases where a file path/identifier sits NEXT TO an intact trigger word. Recommend scoping the token-stripping regex so it does not consume a segment that is itself one of the trigger words (or requires a path-shaped segment such as a slash or recognizable extension) and add smoke coverage for hyphenated-trigger-word phrasing.
findings.resolvedReason: stripCodeLikeTokens no longer strips hyphen-only tokens; only backticked spans, slash tokens, and dotted tokens are removed. RED-first smoke cases (hyphenTriggerDone deferred-for-now, hyphenExcludedDone excluded-here => gap fires; bareFileNameDone partial-done-recovery.ts => no gap) verified failing pre-fix and passing post-fix; milestone-done-gate-reconciliation smoke and milestone-status tests green. Residual (bare extensionless hyphenated file name) documented in plan.md and code comment.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:1391 stripCodeLikeTokens (F-001 fix) still allows a residual bypass class: the dotted-token strip regex /\b[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)+\b/g permits hyphens INSIDE each dot-separated segment, so a hyphenated trigger word followed by a dotted suffix (version tag, abbreviation, etc.) still gets fully erased before the claimsShrinkage scan runs. Verified live against the exact post-fix code: stripCodeLikeTokens("The remaining-scope.v2 items were dropped.") -> "The   items were dropped." (no match); same for "excluded-set.beta", "partial-release.rc1", "deferred-work.next" -- all natural-sounding prose phrasings, not just contrived file paths. This is the same class of failure F-001 identified (a sanitizer intended for path-like tokens erasing genuine prose trigger words), just requiring one extra dot to re-open it. The CHK-001 adversarial verification intent (sanitize-path-tokens:adversarial) and the F-001 resolution both require the sanitizer not become a bypass for genuine shrinkage claims; this residual violates that. The smoke suite has no coverage for hyphen+dot combined tokens. Recommend either: (a) require the dot-containing segment to look extension-like (e.g. final segment is a short alnum-only suffix with no further trigger-word semantics, or bound segment length), or (b) split the token strip so hyphen segments are tested individually for trigger words before the whole token is discarded, or (c) at minimum only strip the dotted suffix segment (e.g. ".v2") rather than the entire hyphen-joined token, so "remaining-scope" survives.
findings.resolvedReason: dottedFileTokenRegex now requires a known file-extension suffix (curated list) before stripping; partial-release.rc1 / deferred-work.next keep their trigger segments and fire the gap (dottedSuffixDone / dottedSuffixDeferredDone RED-first cases verified failing pre-fix, passing post-fix); partial-done-recovery.ts and partial-recovery.test.mjs still strip (bareFileNameDone / multiDotFileDone). milestone-done-gate-reconciliation smoke + milestone-status tests green. Residuals (extensionless hyphenated file name, dotted identifier with non-extension tail) documented in plan.md and code comment.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:1454 the CHK-003 narrowed remaining-trigger regex (remaining\s+(?:work|scope|items?|cases?|...)) requires WHITESPACE between "remaining" and the scope noun, so a hyphen-joined natural phrasing like "remaining-scope", "remaining-work", or "remaining-cases" never matches at all -- the text is not even touched by stripCodeLikeTokens (verified live: stripCodeLikeTokens("The remaining-scope items were pushed to a follow-up story.") returns the string UNCHANGED, yet claimsShrinkage regex still returns false because \s+ cannot span the hyphen). This is a distinct, independently-fixable bug from the F-001/F-002 sanitizer-stripping class (no stripping happens here at all) and is reachable through entirely natural prose -- hyphenated compounds are the dominant style already used elsewhere in this very story (partial-done-recovery, deferred-for-now, excluded-here). It defeats the CHK-003 checklist item this diff explicitly introduces: a genuine DONE-summary shrinkage claim phrased as "remaining-scope items were pushed to a follow-up story" silently produces NO unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage gap, i.e. narrow/partial delivery could be marked DONE without a confirmed shrinkage decision. No smoke coverage exists for the hyphenated form (proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts only covers whitespace-separated "remaining scope"/"remaining cases"). Recommend widening the connector from \s+ to [\s-]+ (or [\s_-]+) in the remaining alternative so remaining-scope/remaining_scope/remaining scope all match consistently.
findings.resolvedReason: claimsShrinkage remaining alternative now uses remaining[\s_-]+<scope-noun>; hyphenRemainingDone (remaining-scope items) and underscoreRemainingDone (remaining_work backlog) RED-first cases verified failing pre-fix and passing post-fix; full intent-hardening smoke, milestone-done-gate-reconciliation smoke, and milestone-status tests green. plan.md CHK-003 decision section updated with the connector revision.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:1389-1393 dottedFileTokenRegex (F-002 fix) still allows a fourth, independently-reachable bypass class: CODE_FILE_EXTENSION_PATTERN is a curated list of file extensions, several of which are also ordinary short English words (go, c, h, m, log, map, rb, cs, rs, sh). A hyphenated trigger word followed by a dot and one of these common-word extensions is fully erased before the claimsShrinkage scan runs, exactly like the F-001/F-002/F-003 bypass classes, and this exact vulnerability class is NOT covered by the story's documented residuals (plan.md 'Risk notes' only accepts false-POSITIVE residuals -- config.partial.enabled, bare partial-done-recovery -- never a false-NEGATIVE/bypass residual). Verified live twice: (1) standalone copy of the exact current stripCodeLikeTokens/dottedFileTokenRegex/CODE_FILE_EXTENSION_PATTERN source run directly, and (2) executing the actual CLI/dist build via a temporary smoke assertion (done_intent_equivalence_check on a lightweight story), both showing zero gaps for both of the following natural-prose DONE-summary limitations texts: 'The excluded-approach.log entry was removed from this delivery.' -> stripCodeLikeTokens produces 'The   entry was removed.' (excluded silently erased, done_intent_equivalence_check gaps=[]); 'The deferred-plan.go decision was made anyway, skipping the rest.' -> 'The   decision was made anyway, skipping the rest.' (deferred silently erased, gaps=[]). Same reproduces for partial-credit.c, narrow-margin.m, deferred-query.sql, narrow-focus.go -- any hyphenated trigger word whose dotted suffix happens to be a curated extension. This means a genuine narrow/partial-delivery DONE summary phrased with an ordinary hyphen-dot-word construction can silently bypass unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage and reach DONE without a confirmed shrinkage decision -- the same guard-weakening risk the CHK-001 adversarial verification intent (sanitize-path-tokens:adversarial) and F-001/F-002/F-003 resolutions were meant to close. No smoke coverage exists for extension-collision tokens (proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts covers only .rc1/.next/.v2/.beta/.ts/.mjs style suffixes, none of which collide with a trigger-adjacent common word). Recommend one of: (a) require the extension segment to be preceded by a genuine multi-char identifier-like prefix AND require the whole token to also satisfy a minimum-token-count or slash-adjacency heuristic before stripping (reduces prose collision surface), (b) narrow CODE_FILE_EXTENSION_PATTERN to drop 1-2 letter/common-word entries (c, h, m, go, rs, cs, rb, sh, log, map) or require a longer curated set with a length floor, or (c) split the dotted-suffix strip so only the suffix segment (e.g. '.go') is removed rather than the entire hyphen-joined token, so 'deferred-plan' survives even when '.go' is stripped (mirrors the F-002 recommendation (c) that was not adopted). Add smoke coverage for at least one extension-collision case in both directions (bypass reproduced pre-fix, blocked post-fix).
findings.dismissReason: Re-filing with correct agent attribution (lattice-review-test-coverage) — original finding_add call omitted agent and was recorded as agent=main, which does not count as reviewer evidence per the tool warning.
